verdict.rationale: The evidence pack contains no mention of a Vulkan backend or any AMD-specific acceleration path in LM Studio's docs, and a community comment explicitly wishes LM Studio 'played better with AMD hardware' and had an 'off-the-shelf solution that just works on Radeon,' implying no such capability is documented or working. missing for 10: any docs/CLI reference to Vulkan backend, AMD GPU acceleration settings, or benchmarks showing ROCm-free AMD inference.
